slides.content:
Headline (top-left, large): "Only work's own skills move?"
Three option cards across the middle, joined by a wavy line:
 Card A, label "Move all": a whole shelf of books carried into a new room; caption "every task skill"
 Card B, label "Only its own", circled with a thick orange marker loop and a small hand-written tag "leaning": a few books carried to a new room while a shared shelf stays behind; caption "shared ones stay in base"
 Card C, label "Move none": a shelf with new labels stuck on; caption "rename only"
Bottom-right mustard sticky note with a big question mark: "Still open: where do shared helpers go?"
Focal point: card B.
slides.notes: Options: Move all of 1_base/task into 2_theme/work; Move only what work alone uses; shared skills stay in base; Move nothing; rename folders only. Leaning: the second (Q04 proposal). Still open: agents/ and haipipe-page-task are called by other themes too; where do they go?

slides.content:
Headline (top-left, large): "The Task contract stays shared?"
Three option cards across the middle, joined by a wavy line:
 Card A, label "Stays in base", circled with a thick orange marker loop and a small hand-written tag "leaning": one central toolbox with four arrows reaching it from four small houses; caption "every theme calls it"
 Card B, label "Moves to work": the toolbox inside one house, the other houses reaching across; caption "others call across"
 Card C, label "Splits": the toolbox cut in two, one half staying, one half moving; caption "contract stays, kinds move"
Bottom-right mustard sticky note with a big question mark: "Still open: is a big rename worth it?"
Focal point: card A.
slides.notes: Options: It stays in base: insight, discovery and paper call it; It moves into work; other themes call across; It splits: the contract stays, the kinds of Task move. Leaning: the first; haipipe-work is already the theme's door. Still open: Renaming haipipe-task would touch about 830 files; is it worth it?

slides.idea: Where do the data pipelines go?
slides.content:
Headline (top-left, large): "Where do the pipelines live?"
Three option cards across the middle, joined by a wavy line, all the same weight (no favourite yet):
 Card A, label "Stay in base": a long pipe running under several houses; caption "shared by all"
 Card B, label "Own theme": the pipe inside its own small house; caption "a pipeline theme"
 Card C, label "Join work": the pipe running into one workshop; caption "part of work"
Bottom-right mustard sticky note with a big question mark: "Still open: split 1_data into two?"
Focal point: the headline, then the three cards evenly.
slides.notes: Options: They stay in base; They become their own theme; They join work. Still open: Each numbered folder (1_data, 2_nn, 3_end, 4_individual) holds a work kind and a pipeline; split them?
